title: Holding
description: A thing in progress and who holds it (doctrine D-056, spec 111): a request, a step of a circuit, a draft to check, an action from a meeting, an agent's task. It always has a holder — a person, who answers for it (D-061); an agent works it as its delegate — and may wait on someone. An app says it under its source; said again under the same source, it replaces what was said. The center gives it its id.

id.description: Given by the center when it keeps the holding; absent when an app says it.

source.description: Where it comes from: one holding per app, kind and reference.

kind.description: What it is in that app: request, todo, meeting_action, circuit_step, draft, agent_task…

object.description: What it is about: a project, a party, a quote, a ticket, an asset.

what.description: What is to be done, as a person reads it: « Chiffrer le devis Garage Bè ».

holder.description: Who holds it now, and answers for it. Never nobody. A person (D-061): an agent is its delegate. The kind `agent` is still read, deprecated: the center makes the agent's person the holder and the agent its delegate.

delegate.description: The agent working it for its holder (D-061, spec 140): the holder still answers for it.

return_to.description: Whom the result goes to when it is done: the next step's person by the policy or the circuit, else whoever entrusted it (D-061, spec 140).

waiting_on.description: Who it waits for: a colleague, an agent, a party outside, or another holding (it comes back to its holder when that one is done); none when it is in the holder's hands.

since.description: Since when it is in progress.

due.description: The day it is due, in the organization's time.

priority.description: How urgent: « Pour moi » sorts by it first. Absent: normal.

snoozed_until.description: Before this moment, « Pour moi » does not show it: the holder put it off.

state.description: held: in the holder's hands. waiting: it waits on someone. done: finished.

href.description: Where it opens: an https address of the app that says it, or a path of the center. Absent: the center finds its way from the source.

for.description: action: the holder must act. information: the holder is told, nothing more.
